snippet.title: Dead in Antares - Full Dev Diary
snippet.description:
Last month, ActuGaming came to our office to record a making-of about the development of Dead in Antares. In this video, Matthieu (Creative Director), Thomas (Lead Game Designer), Julie (Art Director), and Antoine (Sound Designer/Composer) talk about their inspirations, and how they're working hard to create the best "Dead in" experience for all players.

Dead in Antares will be released on Steam in late 2025.

Wishlist Dead in Antares on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2511800/Dead_in_Antares/
